text_block_list.text:
Alright...! 
I managed to take 1st place!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'm so happy...!
This proves it now, right?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm fast! With everyone pushing me forward,
look at just how fast I can run!
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was a textbook victory!
Yeah, that was an ideal win!
Stay focused and let's win the next one too!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! Thank you very much!
It's all thanks to you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if this repaid the people who cheered for me, even just a little.
I hope it did...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Alright, keep your eyes on me next time too!
I'll bring joy to everyone once again!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! ...Fufu, I'm sorry.
I got a little carried away.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "I have to prove that this victory wasn't just a fluke... We're still only halfway there."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—I'm gonna keep on running like this.
I'll show you that I can make miracles happen, again and again!
